variants.headline: A company goes under
variants.body: A company has gone under in {colony}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Business failure enters the colony's record
variants.body: The colony has seen a company fail. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: An enterprise reaches failure
variants.body: A business in the colony has gone under. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
